articles.body:
There are 127 Unique Weapon Variants to discover in GTA 6 , plus an extra two if you purchased the Ultimate Edition. These are weapons you'll find by progressing through Jason and Lucia's story, busting Illegal Operations, exploring the world of Leonida and Vice City, and occasionally as a rare Ammu-Nation find.

Unlike standard weapons, Unique Weapon Variants cannot be modified or customized cosmetically . Why mess with something perfect? Each Unique Weapon Variant has a unique look you won't be able to replicate with modifications at any ol' Ammu-Nation. Good news is, all Unique Weapon Variants are automatically unlocked for both Jason and Lucia once you have collected one.

Unique Weapon Variants will appear with a yellow gun icon when found in the world, and its name with be yellow when viewed in menus such as your Loadout or Weapons Locker.

Here are all the Unique Weapon Variants you can collect in GTA 6:

All Unique Weapon Variants and Locations

Some Unique Weapon Variants can be purchased for a steep cost at Ammu-Nations around Leonida, while others can only be collected by completing dangerous Illegal Operations or as rewards for finishing side missions and activities. This IGN guide has got you covered, with a list of all the Unique Weapon Variants in GTA 6 and how to unlock them.

There are 30 Unique Variant Pistols in GTA 6 in total. The list below includes images of each Unique Variant Pistol, weapon stats, and info on how to collect them:

The Assassin Nipper .38 Unique Weapon Variant is a Compact Pistol found on the southeastern edge of Permit Keys, east of the Mile Zero Air Station.

You can find the Unique Variant pistol hidden in a small hatch in the floor of a shipwrecked boat. The Assassin Nipper .38 is tied to a side activity puzzle involving a "spy boat".

The Low Point Nipper .38 Unique Weapon Variant is a Compact Pistol, a variant of the Nipper .38 pistol with a rough exterior appearance.

The Turnt Nipper .38 Unique Weapon Variant is a Compact Pistol, a colorful variant of the Nipper .38 which can only be found in a crashed paraglider strung from a tree in Bobcat Bight.

Look for the Turnt Nipper .38 in the seat of the "paratrike" stuck up in the tree. You can find this strange crash site on the northern tip of Bobcat Bay, west of North Mariana County.

The Zodiac Nipper .38 is a Compact Pistol with a blue and purple aesthetic which can be looted during the Ocean Beach Lab Illegal Operation, located in Ocean City.

The Duval Signature ES9 is a Military Pistol, a variant of the ES9 with a sleek, if plain, appearance. It can only be obtained if you own the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition.

Quarter Mile ES9 is a Military Pistol with a sleek silver frame and wooden grip, which can be looted from the Chatfield Storage & Logistics Illegal Operation located in Waxman Island, east of Downtown Vice City.

The Sand Storm ES9 is a Military Pistol with a light gray color and an American flag emboss on the grip. It can be purchased from Big Shots Ammu-Nation store for $1,470. You can find Big Shots on the east side of Hamlet.

The Guardian ES18 is a Burst Pistol with a cream white grip and gold accents. It can be looted during the Saber Shipping Yard Illegal Operation located in Little Cuba, a neighborhood of Vice City.

The Caminos Signature K17 is a Service Pistol with a dark red grip and an opacalescent rose detailing.

DWNPLY's K17 is a Service Pistol with a bright white color and yellow-gold accents.

PTT Youngin$ K17 is a colorful Service Pistol with street art graffiti details, featuring splashes of blue, yellow, and orange. It can be looted during the Kamar Devon Community Center Illegal Operation located in Southside, a neighborhood just north of South Vice-Dale County.

The San4San K17 is a Service Pistol with a modern aesthetic, touched with gold accents, including a scope. It can be looted during the Sound4Sound Studio Illegal Operation found in Stockyard, located on the northernmost end of Vice City.

The Nite Raptor K17 is Service Pistol with a light gray camo aesthetic. It can be purchased at Black Eagle for $2,050. You can find Black Eagle Ammu-Nation weapons store in Balsero, a neighborhood west of Vice City and just east of Bucksin Swamp.

The Dumpster K17 MCD is an Automatic Pistol with a dark purple frame and a "Grease Nation" decal on its grip.

The Stoner K17 MCD is an Automatic Pistol with a sleek black-and-white aesthetic.

At the Big Day Motel off of US-35 just north of Ambrosia, inside room 115. Don't mind the people inside the room. Simply enter to find the Stoner K17 MCD on the nightstand to the right of the bed.

The Patriarch DRX is a Tactical Pistol with a matte black frame and accents of metallic purple-blue.

In a submerged car in the southwest part of the Kalaga Reservoir. Look for luggage and miscellaneous items strewn about near the bank, then head into the water to find the sunken car just past the overgrown algae. Pick up the Patriarch DRX beside the car underwater.

The Rogue Alpha DRX is a Tactical Pistol with a sleek light-gray aesthetic and a dark gray "star" detail on the barrel. It can be purchased at Quickscope for $4,410. You can find the Quickscope Ammu-Nation store across the street from Kensinger Tower in Downtown Vice City.

The Brainwasher 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a pink and white psychedelic detail on the frame and green and white checkered pattern on its grip.

Brian's 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a sleek black frame and dark wooden grip.

The Deadringer 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a silver frame and light wooden grip, both embossed with filigree details.

You can find the Deadringer 1992 inside a mobile home on the south bank of the Moreau River in East Lummox County. Don't be alarmed by the man who may run at you. Head inside and look on the floor to find it by a man's feet.

The Money Bag 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a dark steel frame and wooden grip, with filigree embossed into the barrel.

Inside a mobile home on the south bank of the Moreau River in East Lummox County. Don't be alarmed by the man who may run at you. Head inside and look on the couch to the right to find the Money Bag 1922.

Martha's 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a rusted metal frame and worn wooden grip, with "M&L" carved into the grip.

In the fireplace of an old, abandoned "Outlaw's Cabin" in Moreau. Enter the cellar of the structure by going down the stairs on its southeast side. Climb the stairs straight up into the main room, then search the fireplace to find Martha's 1922.

Monty's 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a yellow-gold coloring, embossed frame, and a filigree texture inlaid in the grip.

Raul's 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a sleek steel gray frame and black grip, with the decal "CAPO" on the barrel's side.

Russo's 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a steel frame with a greenish sheen, and a dark wooden grip.

The Silver 1992 is a Heavy Pistol with a shiny steel frame and textured grip, with the decal "CAPO" on the barrel's side. It can be purchased at Big Shots for $2,210. You can find Big Shots Ammu-Nation weapon store on the east side of Hamlet, a neighborhood south of Vice City.

The Black Eagle Import Kalinga is a .50 Cal Pistol with a dark gray frame and bright red grip. Its barrel has zebra accents embossed along the top.

You can find the Black Eagle Import Kalinga inside the Black Eagle warehouse besides the Black Eagle store in Balsero. The Black Eagle Import Kalinga .50 is inside the safe in the office in the front corner. Find the code to the safe by looking at the log in screen of the desktop inside the office. The office is also protected by a keycode.

The Convict Kalinga .50 is a .50 Cal Pistol with a dark purple frame and grip, featuring accents of black and bright red.

Gil's Kalinga .50 is a .50 Pistol with a spray-painted red and black frame, and a... questionable placement of a woman illustrated along the grip.

The Iron & Oak WCR-1 is a Compact Revolver with an orange frame and golden wooden grip. It can be purchased at Iron & Oak for $1,260. You can find Iron & Oak in the northernmost end of Vice City, in a neighborhood called Stockyard.

The Cargo H&L .38 is a Double Action Revolver with a gray frame and brown wooden grip, with burnished-blue metal accents.

In a yellow "Scoop" shipping container in the cargo area of Port Vice City. Behind the stack of containers it's in, there's another stack, with one container short enough to climb. Use it to climb to the top of this stack, then jump to the rust container.

Climb over the black container to reach the yellow shipping container on the other side. Break into the yellow shipping container to find the Cargo H&L .38. Be wary of security here.

Donnie's H&L .38 is a Double Action Revolver with a black frame and light gray grip, embossed withy details of a hawk and flowers.

Lyle's H&L .38 is a Double Action Revolver with a rusted frame and worn wooden grip. It has the detail "M&L" engraved in the barrel.

You will find Lyle's H&L .38 in the trunk of a car inside an old barn at the deadend of a road in Bonanza. Enter from the side door, then open the trunk to find Lyle's H&L .38.

Ride Free H&L .38 is a Double Action Revolver with a narrow wooden grip, and shiny dark gray barrel. It has the Hawk & Little local engraved on the side. It can be looted during the Biker Hideout Illegal Operation located in Leonard County. You can find the Biker Hideout in a small building on the southern shore of Lake Leonida, west along the road heading out of Ambrosia.

The Jack Sheepe H&L .38 is a Double Action Revolver with a cherry red frame and textured grip. It has a "Jack Sheepe" decal along its narrow barrel. The Jack Sheepe H&L .38 is only available if you have purchased the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6. You can purchase the Jack Sheepe H&L .38 at Biff's Gun Supply for $2,260. You can find Biff's Gun Supply in the northwestern corner of Ambrosia, the town southwest of Lake Leonida.

The Couch Potato Mustang .357 is a Magnum Revolver with a rusted black aesthetic, and white grip tape tied around the grip. You can find th Couch Potato Mustang .357 hidden inside a couch hanging from a tree in front of a mobile home off of Tanglewood Ln. in Port Gellhorn.

Shoot the ropes attached to the couch to release it to the ground. Then, sit on the couch to find the Couch Potato Mustang .357

The Honky Tonk Mustang .357 is a Magnum Revolver with a vintage aesthetic, sporting a dark brown barrel and grip with burnished gold accents. It can be purchased at Phil's Ammu-Nation for $3,780. You can find Phil's Ammu-Nation on the soutmost side of Vice City, in a neighborhood called Southside.

The Kingfishers Akulus is a Heavy Revolver with a camo aesthetic and black grip. It can be looted during the Sunrise RV Park Illegal Operation . You can find the Sunrise RV Park north of Cottonmouth Lake, northwest of Key Lento and Gambit Bay.

The Swamp Bait Akulus is a Heavy Revolver with a gray steel barrel and warped green-and-black grip.

You can find the Swamp Bait Akulus in the marsh just south west of Hamlet inside a waterfront structure. The Swamp Bait Akulus is on the floor inside the larger structure.

Bae-Lux's W-10 is a Micro SMG, with an ombre purple-and-pink wrap job, accented with zebra stripes.

The Chromium W-10 is a Micro SMG with a chrome, cylindrical barrel. It can be looted during the La Perle Trap House Illegal Operation located on the north side of Vice City. You can find the La Perle Trap House in a neighborhood called La Perle.

The Little Friend W-10 is a Micro SMG with a matte black-gray finish.

You can find the Little Friend W-10 in a room on the second floor of the Sunlite Motel in Ocean Beach off of Shore Drive. Go up the stairs beneath the red awning to find a doorway splattered with blood on the right. The Little Friend W-10 is just inside on the floor amongst a crime scene.

Roxy's W-10 is a cute Micro SMG with a magenta wrap job, featuring cheetah print accents.

Tyrone's W-10 is a Micro SMG with a dull gold frame and grip.

The Moneymaker W-10 is a Micro SMG with a navy blue frame and gold accents, including a shiny gold barrel. It can be purchased at Tequesta Guns & Ammo for $1,557. Look for Tequesta Guns & Ammo in the southwest part of Tequesta.

The Marabunta Grande Type 9 is a Machine Pistol SMG, with gold accents along its barrel, frame, and magazine. It can be looted during the Weed Grow Illegal Operation, located in East Lummox County. You can find the Weed Grow farm on the northeast shore of Lake Tallaloko.

The Neon Sunset Type 9 is a Machine Pistol SMG with a navy blue frame, neon blue barrel, and pink graffiti art-style decals. It can be purchased at Vice City Firearms for $2,310. You can find Vice City Firearms in Salton.

In an underground armory beneath a hatch in a mobile home in Balsero, just south west of the Griffin Shooting Range.

Enter the mobile home through a side door, open the latch in the back, and climb down the ladder to find the Conspiracist Type 9 on the table.

The Eris Fresh DSG is a Tactical SMG which can be looted during the Illegal Goods Store Illegal Operation. You can find the Illegal Goods Store on the northern end of Southside, one of the southmost neighborhoods of Vice City.

The Chronic Vatra is a Heavy SMG with neon green and purple accents, and a decal of two skeletal hands reaching out along the stock. It can be looted during the Industrial Weed Grow Illegal Operation , located in North Mariana County. You can find the Industrial Weed Grow headquartered north of Tola Bay and Big Pine.

The Double Cross Vatra is a Heavy SMG with a severely rusted frame.

You can find the Double Cross Vatra at the bottom of Gulf Leonida, west of Bobcat Key in Mariana County. The Double Cross Vatra is just sitting in the sand at the bottom of the sea, but there are three corpses floating near the surace of the water (and possibly a boat) to mark its location below.

The Kolt & Associates Vatra is a Heavy SMG with a bright green frame, black stock and magazine, and a faded decal for "Lube Bros". It can be looted during the June Warehouse Illegal Operation located in Port Gellhorn. You can find June Warehouse across the street from Sarena's Bargain Store, closer to the south side of Port Gellhorn.

The Spangled Vatra is a Heavy Submachine Gun with an American flag wrap job on its frame. It can be purchased at Jackson Firearms for $2,520. You can find Jackson Firearms in the southeast corner of Balsero, a neighborhood located in northwest Vice City.

The Furry DW-9 is a Combat SMG with a beautifully airbrushed... well, fursona on its frame.

The Dazzler DQ-9 is a Combat SMG with a dark green camo wrap job on its frame and stock. It can be purchased from Iron & Oak for $3,680. You can find Iron & Oak in the northmost side of Vice City, in a neighborhood called Stockyard.

The Crabshack VF5 is a Military SMG with a nuclear waste-themed wrap job, smeared in blood.

You can find the Crabshack VF5 in a boat shack, part of an abandoned research outpost in Pelican Valley. Use the code to open the door from the boardwalk. The Crabshack V5F is on the ground next to a researcher who met an unfortunate end.

The Guardia Brothers VF5 is a Military SMG with a tan frame and pink camo accents. It can be looted during the Saber Shipping Facility Illegal Operations located in Balsero. You can find the Saber Shipping Facility on the eastern side of the neighborhood, overlooking the river which runs between Balsero and Rockridge.

The Midlife Crisis VF5 is a Military SMG with a golden-tan frame and a long magazine.

The Scrapper VF5C is a Compact Military SMG with a dull green frame, accented with scribbles of gold marker. It can be looted during the La Cascara Motel Mote Illegal Operation located in Port Gellhorn. You can find La Cascara Motel on the shore of Draper Bay, southwest from Gellhorn Outfitters.

The Gutterball Moreland 850 is a Pump Action Shotgun with a blue and black ombre color, and a bowling pin decal on its stock. It can be looted during the Kingpin Bowling Illegal Operation located in Port Gellhorn. You can find the abandoned Kingpin Bowling alley on the south end of Gellhorn.

The Watcher Pro Moreland 850 is a Pump Action Shotgun with an olive green frame, black stock, and black grip. It can be purchased from Tactical Outlet Guns for $1,470. You can find Tactical Outlet Guns Ammu-Nation store on the far west side of Belville.

The CPD Moreland 850 is a Pump Action Shotgun with a light silver frame and black stock and grip.

San4San Gorse 425 is a Stubby Shotgun with a dull gold frame, and San4San Gorse accents decorated along its grip and stock. It can be looted during the Parlor Apartments Illegal Operation located in Rockridge. You can find the Parlor Apartments across the street from the Rockridge Blood Center in the southwest corner of the neighborhood.

Smuggler Gorse 425 is a Stubby Shotgun with a dull green frame, and a spray painted decal of a death's head moth near the stock. It can be found in an abandoned smuggler's boat washed up on the shore of a small island east of Mile Zero Air Station, in Permit Keys.

The Basher Gorse 425 is a Stubby Shotgun with a dull tan frame and worn brown stock. It can be purchased at the Pawn & Gun located in Port Gellhorn. You can find this location of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation store towards the south side of Gellhorn.

The Dirty Drifter is a Double Barrel Shotgun with a black barrel, gold accents, and a stock decorated with gray-green and brown brush strokes.

You can find the Dirty Drifte in the trunk of a blue car stuck in a mudslide, just off the coastal road in Bonanza. Climb the bank where the mudslide happened and open the trunk of the car to find the Dirty Drifter.

The Darknite Drifter is a Double Barrel Shotgun with gold filigree embossed on its barrel, and an old-timey illustration on its stock. It can be purchased at the Shrewsbury Drifter for $2,420. You can find the Shrewsbury Drifter Ammu-Nation store along the northwest edge of Port Gellhorn/

The Marabunta Grande Hobo is a Double Barrel Sawed-Off Shotgun with dark wooden accents on its barrel and stock, and gold filigree inlaid above its trigger, including the words "La Familia Primero".

The Backdoor Hobo is a Double Barrel Sawed-Off Shotgun with yellow tape wrapped around its brown wooden stock. It can be purchased at Zenon's Pawn Shop for $2,502. You can find Zenon's Pawn Shop Ammu-Nation store in La Perle, a neighborhood in north Vice City.

The Final Chapter Shortstraw is a Sporting Sawed-Off with a chestnut wooden grip and stock, and two ducks embossed near the trigger. It can be looted during the Hog Stars Garage Illegal Operation, located in Ambrosia. You can find Hog Stars Garage nearby the Pay 'N' Spray in Ambrosia.

The Woodhatch Longshot is a Sporting Shotgun with a sleek wooden stock and black barrel. It can be purchased at Woodhatch for $2,990. You can find the Woodhatch Ammu-Nation store in Capri, the wealthy neighborhood west of North Mariana County.

The Nitepower AZ1200 is a Semi-Auto Shotgun with a gray camo wrap job and an eagle decal on its stock. It can be purchased at Black Eagle for $4,830. You can find the Black Eagle Ammu-Nation store right by the Griffin Shooting Range, on the north side of Balsero.

The Throttler Vero is a Semi-Auto Stubby Shotgun with a yellow and red flame decal along its frame. It can be looted during the Farm Fix Meth Lab Illegal Operation, located in the northern half of Belville, south of Lake Leonida.

The Hostile Super400 is a Heavy Shotgun with a light blue frame and graffiti art-style accents on its frame and stock. It can be looted during the Mill Station Radar Base Illegal Operation, located in Grassrivers. You can find Mill Station Radar Base north of Watson Bay.

The Bruiser Super400 is a Heavy Shotgun with a dark wooden stock and grip, and dull black barrel. It can be purchased at Vice City Gun & Pawn for $5,930. You can find Vice City Gun & Pawn on the south side of Rockridge in Vice City.

The Final Chapter KVGA-12 is an Auto Shotgun with a faded wooden frame and black stock. It has flames and grim reaper decals embossed on it. It can be looted during the Irons Building Supply Illegal Operation located in Ambrosia, the town southwest of Lake Leonida.

Hellspawn Comshot 12 is a Combat Shotgun with a dark red frame and an uncomfortably... fleshy looking grip.

The Hellspawn Comshot is the reward for completing a challenge located at a campsite off a side road in the mountains in the west of North Kelly County.

The challenge is triggered by eating something on the carved wooden throne here. Survive and complete the challenge to find the Hellspawn Comshot 12 leaning against the throne. You'll get a new Circles of Hell shirt, too.

The Unpacked Comshot 12 is a Combat Shotgun with a dull black, minimalist aesthetic.

The Unpacked Comshot 12 is in an ensuite upstairs bathroom behind the door in a house on the northwest coast of Key Lento. Head up the outdoor stairs and break into the second story. From either door, make a right down the hallway and turn left into a back bedroom, and look for an ensuite bathroom on the left. Enter the bathroom.

The Unpacked Comshot 12 is behind the bathroom door, leaning against the wall. There's actually a note on the kitchen counter about the unpacked gun, too, alerting you to its existence in the first place.

The Clunker 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a black barrel, military green and tan frame, and painted white American flag decal on its magazine.

It can be looted during the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation located in Port Gellhorn. You can find Brooks Boatworks on the north side of Port Gellhorn, right by the shore. Keep an eye out for the small two-story building on the north side of the boatworks yard. You'll find the Clunk 556 in its case in the office on the second floor.

The Cockroach Xtreme 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a dark blue and black frame and gold accents. You can find Cockroach Xtreme 556 inside a one car garage in the courtyard of the Sunrise Motel, located in Tequesta in Vice-Dale County.

Enter the garage from the south and look behind the stack of toilet paper to find the Cockroach Xtreme 556.

The Cold War 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a dull black frame and a brown accent on its stock. You can find the Cold War 556 just inside a bunker in Big Pine of North Mariana County.

Enter the structure from the southwest, and find the Cold War 556 leaning up against a wooden shipping crate in the back left of the entrance.

The GRX 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with an army green frame and camo wrap job on its stock. You can loot the GRX 556 during the Leonida Carrier Warehouse Illegal Operation located right smack-dab in the heart of Balsero.

The Kolt & Associates 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a worn blue and gray frame, and a faded skull sticker decal on its stock. It can be looted during the Stash House Illegal Operation located in Port Gellhorn. You can find the Stash House on the north side of Gellhorn, not too far east from Brooks Boatworks.

Raul's CQB 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a black frame and dull tan magazine and grip.

Raul's Heist 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with a black frame and dark tan accents on its grip, scope, and stock.

The Star Spangled 556 is a Carbine Assault Rifle with an American flag wrap job on its frame, accented with black on its grip, stock, and magazine. It can be purchased from Phil's Ammu-Nation for $3,050. You can find Phil's Ammu-Nation in Southside, a neighborhood south of Vice City that is right on the South Vice-Dale County line.

The Kingpin Heathen is a Bullpup Assault Rifle with a sleek gray frame with a checkered texture, and gold accents on its barrel and magazine. It can be looted during the Vespucci Mansion Illegal Operation located on Vespucci Island. Look for the oblong, center island of the Rialto Islands, in the bay between Vice City and Vice Beach.

The Vice City Heathen is a Bullpup Assault Rifle with a dull black frame and a neon pink and blue "Vice City" decal. It can be purchased at Prestige Firearms for $5,150. Look for the Prestige Firearms Ammu-Nation location on the north side of Ocean Beach.

La Polilla Negra VF-G1 is a Special Assault Rifle with a black frame, accented with a gold barrel and magazine. Filigree is inlaid in the frame, and a golden death's head moth decal is painted above the magazine. It can be looted during the Watson Bay Safehouse Illegal Operation located in Watson Bay, west of Hamlet. Look for the safehouse right outside the town limits on its east side.

Drug Mule KZ-59 is an Assault Rifle with a faded black frame and brown leather grip. It can be found underwater, beneath a sunken ship off the north coast of Riquezas Keys, northwest of the Mile Zero Air Station.

Look for suspicious packages floating on the surface , dive down, and look beneath a sunken speedboat to find the Drug Mule KZ-59.

The La Polilla Negra KZ-59 is an Assault Rifle with a golden yellow frame, texture with filigree and a dark stock. It can be looted during the Palmer Fishing Warehouse Illegal Operation located in Watson Bay, a neighborhood west of Hamlet.

Look for the Palmer Fishing Warehouse on the southeast tip of the Bobcat Keys sandbar right near Watson Bay.

The Marabunta Grande KZ-59 is an Assault Rifle with a burnished gold frame and magazine. It can be looted during the Nova Auto Junkyard Illegal Operation located in Hamlet. Look for the Nova Auto Junkyard behind Sara's Unisex Salon and Maximo Grill in the center of Hamlet.

Pete's KZ-59 is an Assault Rifle with black frame, dark leather stock, and chestnut leather magazine.

San4San KZ-59 is an Assault Rifle with a red, abstract wrap job on its frame and stock. You can loot it at the Janjak's Garage Illegal Operation located in the south part of La Perle in Vice City.

The Little Cuba Hind is a Compact Assault Rifle with a yellow and orange frame, worn wooden accent near its barrel, and a domino decal above the magazine surrounded by pink flowers. It can be purchased at Martez Empeños for $3,570. Look for Martez Empeños in Little Cuba, a neighborhood in the southwest of Vice City.

The Guardia Brothers FRA can be looted during the Casa Guardia Illegal Operation located in the northeast corner Little Cuba.

The Kingfishers W-22 is a Small Game Rifle with a brown camo frame and "Wortham" logo along its magazine. You can loot it from the Fishing Shacks Illegal Operation located in Wetman Bay, the swampy area southwest of Hamlet.

Redneck W-22 is a Small Game Rifle with a gray camo wrap, featuring tiremarks across the stock.

Inside a yellow, abandoned train car on the north bank of a river in Moreau. Enter the train car from an opening on the southside to find the Redneck W-22 in the back.

The Mossy Mediator is a Small Game Rifle with an army green color and faded orange dots along its frame. It can be purchased at Barrage Gun Supply for $1,890. Look for the Barrage Gun Supply Ammu-Nation store in Southwind, the only neighborhood by Mile Zero Air Station on the farthest south point of Leonida.

The Copperheads W-14 is a Combat Tactical Rifle with accents of yellow and royal blue along its frame, and a decal saying "We Make Hisss-tory". There is an image of a snake on its magazine.

The Black Eagle Import M306 TMR is a Marksman Elite Rifle with a sleek black frame and glossy black barrel.

You can find the Black Eagle Import M306 TMR inside the Black Eagle warehouse beside the Black Eagle Ammu-Nation store in Balsero. You will need to be Lucia to get this weapon. Enter through the garage opening, then look for the barred door behind the cargo truck inside.

Pass through the barred door and immediately turn left to squeeze between the stack of cardboard boxes and the chainlink wall - Jason won't fit. The Black Eagle Import M306 TMR is in a case just past here. Beware, employees will call the cops on you, so be quick or sneaky.

The Hunter's Laird 350 is a Sporting Sniper Rifle with a beautifully warped wooden frame, featuring stripes of brown, blue, and gray.

Kingfishers Laird 350 is a Sporting Sniper Rifle with a unique gray camo wrap job, featuring hints of white, black, and orange. You can loot the Kingfishers Laird 350 during the Manatee Motel Illegal Operation located in Gullet Marsh, just a bit southwest of Hamlet.

The Mister Mangrove Laird 350 is a Sporting Sniper Rifle with a green camo wrap around its frame and stock.

Twin's Laird 350 is a Sporting Sniper Rifle with a dark wood frame and sleek black barrel.

You can find the Twin's Laird 350 below a small hunting platform in the woods just east of Kalaga Reservoir in Lummox County. Look for the scene of an unfortunate accident involving a hunter to find the Twin's Laird 350 on the ground nearby.

The Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 is a Hunting Sniper Rifle with a beautiful warped wood body, featuring stripes of blue-gray and brown.

You can find the Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 on the boardwalk of a hunter's cabin in the Pelican Valley marsh in Marion County. The Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 is on the floor between the two buildings, by some gator carcasses.

The Fincredible Laird 350 is a Sporting Sniper Rifle with a green fish scale wrap around its frame, making the stock appear like an open-mouthed fish. It can be purchased at Guns Aplenty! for $2000. Look for Guns Aplenty! in Watson Bay, a small neighborhood west of Hamlet and the Gullet Marsh.

The Killtelligence SM-69 is a Hunting Sniper Rifle with a gray camo frame and sleek black barrel. Killtelligence SM-69 is given you to by Bret Vogel when starting the Hunting side quests .

The Firebreak SM-69 is a Hunting Sniper Rifle with an orange and gray-style camo wrap. It can be purchased at R. Willis Jr. Supplies for $3,890. You can find the R. Willis Jr. Supplies Ammu-Nation store in Lummox County, northwest of Kalaga Reservoir.

The Gun Nut SMS-01 is an Advanced Sniper Rifle with an American flag wrap with flames and "America" written across the frame.

The IAA SMS-01 is an Advanced Sniper Rifle with a long black frame and barrel, and an army green scope.

You can find the IAA SMS-01 on the very top of the roof of Aichi Condominiums on Northside Ave on Washington Beach.

You must complete a related Mission in order for this Unique Weapon Variant to appear at this location.

The FIB SM-69 is a Hunting Sniper Rifle with a matte black frame.

You can find the FIB SM-69 at the top of a skyscraper in Vice Beach, between two hospitals.

You need to complete a related mission before the FIB SM-69 will appear in this location.

The Internal Affairs FF-SR is a Combat Sniper Rifle with a dull green frame and black accents.

You can find the Internal Affairs FF-SR at the top of a skyscraper on Washington Beach, where there's a helicopter pad. The northwest edge of the roof of the tallest building on this stretch of Northside Ave.

The Island Poacher FF-50 is a Heavy Sniper Rifle with a dull green cam wrap with a decal of a three-headed dog, surrounded by a circle with the words "Sapienter Si Sincere".

Francisco's LMG 6 is an Assault Machine Gun with a dark tan color and a camo accent.

The Mercenary LMG 6 is an Assault Machine Gun with a gray, red, and black camo print, featuring red and black accents.

You can find the Mercenary LMG 6 in a yellow "Scoop" shipping container on the northern part of the cargo area in Port Vice City in Vice-Dale County.

There is security to avoid, so we recommend approaching from the water, climbing the ladder, then jumping on top of the blue shipping container to reach the beige one. From there, break into the yellow shipping container to find the Mercenary LMG 6.

The Deever Tech GLR40 is the only Unique Variant Grenade Launcher in GTA 6. It has a dull tan color with a black barrel and grip. You can find the grenade launcher inside a one car garage in the courtyard of the Sunrise Motel, located in Tequesta in Vice-Dale County.

Enter the garage from the south and look behind the stack of toilet paper to find the Deever Tech GLR40

The Brontasaurus Bat is a Unique Variant melee weapon with a metallic green sheen and orange accents.

You can find it inside the batting cages, which are part of Dino Golf off of SR-32 in Frogswater. Simply walk into the batting cages to find the Brontasaurus Bat in one of the individual cages to the right.

The Shark Knife is a special Unique Variant knife you can discover while exploring. Look for it north of the Saint Attaway Islands.

You will find the Shark Knife next to a shark cage with an unfortunate diver and shark stuck inside, at the bottom of the sea in an underwater ravine. Dive down and look for the Shark Knife stuck into the ground between an anemone and the shark cage.

The Explorer's Knife is a Unique Variant melee weapon with a jagged black handle and serrated blade.

You can find the Explorer's Knife in the underground portion of Emerald River, accessible through Selkie Hole. Go through Selkie Hole to pick up scuba equipment and a flashlight.

You can find the Tallaloko Knife on the second floor of a cabin called Evergreen in a small complex of cabins on the west side of Lake Tallaloko in East Lummox County.

Find a way into the Evergreen cabin, climb the stairs, and enter the locked door to find the Tallaloko Knife. You'll also find more than $7k worth of jewelry in the lockbox on the console table.

The Soldier's Combat Knife is a Unique Variant melee weapon with a rusted blade and worn leather handle.

In a partially submerged tank on the central west shore between Bobcat Bight and Bobcat Key. Open the hatch of the tank to find the Soldier's Combat Knife.

articles.title: Apps and Social Media - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Your phone is an essential tool in Grand Theft Auto VI, packed with apps that can get you from A to B, protect your cash, and help you keep in touch with
articles.body:
Your phone is an essential tool in Grand Theft Auto VI, packed with apps that can get you from A to B, protect your cash, and help you keep in touch with important contacts. Apps will naturally unlock as you progress through Lucia and Jason's story, but if you've not yet explored all your newly loaded features, this official IGN GTA 6 guide will help you get familiar with them all.

Your phone will come loaded with several standard apps, which include your Contacts, Camera, Gallery, News, and Weather.

Contacts: If you find a new number, or someone new gets in touch, you'll be able to reach out to them via Contacts.

Camera: Want to take a selfie, or capture something cool you find around Leonida? Open up your camera.

Gallery: If you've already taken a few shots, you can then view them in your Gallery.

News: Stay up to date with all the weird and wonderful things going in Leonida through the red news app. This allows you to scroll through a feed of stories from The Leonida Journal, Weazel News, Vice City Horn, and more.

Weather: Finally, you can get a 2-day forecast by opening up the weather app, and even see when the sun sets.

You'll often see notifications at the top of your phone. This is worth opening up each day, as it gives you hints on outstanding messages, news articles, recent Snapmatic posts, and missed calls that are worth checking out.

Whenever you get a new message, this is where it goes. All unread messages will have a red dot next to them. Contacts can also attach photos, and coordinates, meaning when you open a message, your map will automatically update with new locations.

Traveling around Leonida sometimes means your vehicle is elsewhere. But if you want help with that, Scooter Bros is the app to use. You can set a destination for you car to be sent to. You'll pay a flat fee for the request, then an additional fee for the distance that Scooter Bros need to cover to get the vehicle back to you.

Don't feel like driving? You don't have to, though it can be costly to use the RydeMe app depending on where you're going. You can choose a Ryde, or Book Ryde, and then select Change Destination. This will open up the map, so you just need to place a pin down on where you wanna go.

Who needs a bank account when you can use BuckMe? This app is a quick way to keep track of your finances. You'll have an individual checking account, as well as a savings accounts, where you can keep track of your next goals. Rather than stash your cash away under some floorboards, you'll be able to deposit it quickly into your BuckMe account. All cash will have to be deposited via an ATM, but BuckMe makes it easy to do that. Just use the ATM finder, and the closest ATM will be marked for you.

What you eat, how often you exercise, and your general health will all have an impact on Jason and Lucia's journey. The Fitness app will not only let you track whether or not you're hungry, but also tells you when your workout window is, so you can stay consistent and avoid losing your gains. Additionally, you'll be able to track your Focus Level, which you can improve with a variety of activities including Meditation, Fishing, and Basketball.

All kinds of things are happening in Leonida, and you can keep up with them all via Snapmatic. Explore posts from people you know, or just watch viral videos to pass the time. You can view the comments, and if there's any posts you particularly enjoy, you can like them to view again later.

WAiNK is an app designed for scanning landmarks , locations, sculptures , and vehicles. This app is essential for completing collections and making 100% progress. When there's something nearby that you can scan, you'll get a notification that pops up to tell you that you can WAiNK it.

When you car collection begins to expand, you'll want to dive into the Vice City Real Estate app to see what properties are available. This allows you to purchase garages, so you can unlock more parking spots, and keep your favorite vehicles safe.

Lastly, there's the Settings app. You can make cosmetic adjustments here, including changing your wallpaper and ringtone. But you'll also unlock third party plugins as you progress through the story, including the Cop Scanner and Key Cloner.

articles.title: You Have to Become a Complete Psychopath to Get A 6 Star Wanted Level in GTA 6
articles.summary: GTA 6 sees the return of the classic six-star wanted system, but gaining the highest level demands much more outrageous criminal behaviour than you might expect.
articles.body:
Warning: things are about to get very silly, and you may even question if I have a soul left to save.

Following a brief dip down to five stages in GTA 5, the full six-star wanted level system is back in GTA 6 . As you begin your new criminal adventure, you might be wondering exactly what you need to do to trigger the largest police response to your fiendish Vice City activities. How do you hit the full six stars ?

The short answer is: become a psychopath. The longer answer is a little more complicated, requires quite a bit of effort to get there and, arguably, involves relinquishing each of your morals one by one. Here’s how I got a six-star wanted level in GTA 6.

The classic six wanted stars sit in the top right-hand corner of the HUD throughout your journey across the state of Leonida, but the truth is, over the course of the story, you’ll never quite max them out. Five stars are often triggered during some of the main missions' higher-stakes moments, but that final step remains elusive if you purely follow the story. You really have to go out of your way to draw enough attention from the cops, high-powered NOOSE teams, and whatever land, sea, and air vehicles may be headed your way to hit six stars. Really, the only way to do it is to commit some pretty abhorrent atrocities, mainly involving the murder of dozens of civilians or cops. Furthermore, due to the realistic nature of GTA 6’s world and the lifelike way its population reacts to your every action, it can genuinely be quite a harrowing endeavour, especially when compared to the more cartoonish nature of the series’ previous entries.

Despite all that, I really couldn’t play GTA 6 without seeing what happens at six stars at least once. And so I had to push on, grinding the corpses of innocents beneath my feet and tires, all in the name of curiosity. And journalism (seriously, this is one of the more unusual requests I’ve had from an editor.) Please know that I know how absurd everything I’m about to describe sounds.

As any longtime GTA player will know, a quick and easy way to draw police attention is to break into the airport. Vice City International Airport is located west of Downtown, and there’s a series of barriers to the southeast of the airfield that gets you pretty close to a bunch of private and cargo jets. Putting pedal to the metal, I rammed through the barriers and hijacked the biggest airborne beast I could – I was looking to create as much mayhem as possible, afterall. By the time I hit the runway I had secured four stars – all without killing anyone. Of course, cargo jets are massive and I was planning to make a massive impact, so that non-lethal streak was about to end shortly. Again, all of this really does require you to remember that this is all a video game and these people aren’t real.

Once airborne, I steered the jet southeast to line up its nose with the length of Ocean Beach. Yes, the beach full of happy, joyful, relaxing people. If the high-octane set pieces of the campaign could never trigger five stars, then there really was no other option than the most heinous act I could think of. Unsurprisingly, fighter jets pulled up alongside me, intercepting my mission. I collided with one, bringing this initial attempt to an early finish. If you’re planning on trying this, try to avoid smashing into them.

Another thing to avoid: tearing your landing gear apart by ploughing into the boarding stairs when taking off. That was my second try foiled before I’d even left the runway. Look, I never said I was a professional when it comes to mayhem. But once I’d managed to get in the air with all wheels in tact and avoid the intercepting jets, I was well positioned to land the cargo plane on the sand, piling into as many vacation-goers as possible in one fell swoop.

Despite this act being horrifically, soul-twistingly violent, across my numerous attempts I discovered it wasn’t actually guaranteed to trigger the five star wanted level. Somehow, this was considered by the authorities to be no worse than an airline hijack. If you find yourself in the same position, feel free to lob some sticky bombs at the arriving cops or flick into focus mode to land some clean headshots. That should get you up to five.

At this point, I’d attracted quite the police presence, which meant the beach was swarming with armoured trucks and all-terrain vehicles – the perfect tools to drive up and down the beach, ramming into as many people as possible. Once again, I’m very aware that I’m basically committing a heinous terrorist attack here, but I have been tasked with writing this and am really trying to make it clear that my moral character should not be judged by my actions in a video game, especially not by those in a court of law, thank you very much. Let me know if I’m succeeding.

There’s no doubt a little bit of luck involved with this process, as I failed a couple more times before finally reaching my goal of six stars. Sometimes the police actually proved themselves good at aiming, blowing my tires out and sending me spinning slowly to my death. Or you might make my most stupid mistake, stepping out of the safe confines of my vehicle and taking on the whole of the VCPD with a pistol alone.

After a good five or 10 minutes, though, and with a healthy dose of luck, I did it. Eventually, with what felt like the entire city dead at my feet, the sixth star popped.

Rockstar has clearly made it difficult for that final star to arrive. Even once you’ve completed the story and unlocked the cheat code that instantly raises your heat level, that shortcut will only max out at five stars, meaning the final step into psychopath territory always has to be yours to make.

Six stars come with a pretty significant penalty, though, and a warning will appear on screen before you hit the point of no return. If you max out the wanted level, there truly is no escape, and you’ll be hunted down until you’re dead. There’s no way to lower your wanted level once you hit six stars, and fighting your way out – even if you’re loaded up on high-powered weaponry and adrenaline shots – is incredibly difficult. I look forward to seeing people’s record times being set for how long they can maintain six-star pursuits.

If you’re going to try and unleash this amount of violence, I’d thoroughly recommend making a manual save beforehand, as it’s likely to result in permanent repercussions for both Jason and Lucia, as well as your own psyche. Their criminal profiles can fluctuate throughout the game, but committing crimes like this can easily lead to them becoming “irredeemable”, one step above “psychopath”, meaning there’s no going back and sliding them towards the “professional” end of GTA 6’s morality spectrum. Doing so will have consequences that relate to both the storyline and how people react to you within the world. You are, of course, free to take this path, but, in my opinion, much like Red Dead Redemption 2 before it, the overall tone of the couple’s tale is much more befitting of a man and woman trying to be “better people” rather than mass murderers. The choice is yours, though.

Have you managed to reach six stars on the wanted level yet? How long did you manage to evade the police, if so? Do you think I’m unwell for both writing and doing this? Let us know in the comments!

Simon Cardy is a Senior Editor at IGN who can mainly be found skulking around open world games, indulging in Korean cinema, or despairing at the state of Tottenham Hotspur and the New York Jets. Follow him on Bluesky at @cardy.bsky.social .

articles.title: Rockstar Publishes Full GTA 6 Credits — But Beware, They Contain Major Spoilers
articles.summary: With GTA 6 now launched across the world, Rockstar has published the game's full credits online — with a major spoiler hidden in plain view.
articles.body:
With GTA 6 now launched across the world, Rockstar has published the game's full credits online — with some major spoilers hidden in plain view.

Thousands of developers are named on Rockstar's GTA 6 credits page , which also includes a list of the dozens of cast members who portray characters in the game. We reckon around 6,000 names are on the list.

As revealed earlier this week when her Game Awards nomination was announced, Manni L. Perez is the actress behind main character Lucia Caminos . And as confirmed today via our first photo of the game's stars together in real life , Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason Duval is played by actor Dylan Rourke.

Other major characters include Donnie played by True Detective's Brad Carter, Cal played by former Saturday Night Live cast member Bobby Moynihan, Brian Heder played by King of the Hill voice actor Stephen Root, Lori Heder played by prolific voice actress Orlagh Cassidy and Kenton Rees played by Trinidadian singer and songwriter Machel Montano.

Scroll further down the cast list and players will likely spot something that we're going to absolutely label as a spoiler — it's your choice whether you want to read more right now.

Celebrity names in the cast list include a string of celebrity radio hosts, including "Weird Al" Yankovic as DJ Al, Brigitte Nielsen as Madame Brigitte, Puerto Rican rapper and Super Bowl LX halftime show star Bad Bunny as El Martillo, British acting legend Jeremy Irons as DJ Dicky, Gloria and Emilio Estefan as themselves, The Big Bang Theory's Brian Posehn as Big Fan Brian, and the legendary Keith Richards as DJ Keith.

Development-wise, as you'd expect, Rockstar Games founder and executive producer Sam Houser leads the credits list, alongside head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe, plus co-studio heads Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut. If you're searching for them, the 34 staff fired by Rockstar last year in controversial circumstances are all credited.

There's no sign of Sam Houser's brother and Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser, who left Rockstar in 2020 — despite GTA 6's early development already being underway by this point. GTA 6 is the franchise's first major 3D release not to include his name in the credits. (And no, there's no sign of Leslie Benzies' name either, though he departed several years prior, back in 2016.)

Clearly, GTA 6 was an enormous development effort across Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two, which has yet to announce early sales numbers for the game. We don't know how much GTA 6 cost to make, but we're looking at the most expensive video game ever made, with a budget potentially over the $1 billion mark. Based on preorder estimates, Take-Two will have made its money back on preorders alone.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

articles.title: GTA 6: The Optional Missions You Won’t Want to Miss
articles.summary: GTA 6 is full of optional activities, but some are more essential than others. These are the seven side missions you really shouldn't miss out on.
articles.body:
Jason and Lucia’s story in GTA 6 is so compelling that you’ll be easily tempted into mainlining their epic tale. But outside of those main missions are some of Leonida’s most weird and wonderful encounters, with multi-stage storylines that you’ll rarely be able to guess where they end up. Trust me, you don’t want to risk skipping the game’s best side activities.

Don’t worry, I won’t be revealing how these quests develop. Instead, I’ll just be showing you where to start them, or in the instances where these missions will come directly to you, why you won’t want to pass on something that looks underwhelming on the surface. Anyway, let’s get on with it. Here are the seven optional missions in GTA 6 you won’t want to miss.

Find yourself peacefully sailing through the Grassrivers, only for that peace to be broken by an ungodly screaming, howling, sort of noise? Well, track down the source, and you’ll find one of the first truly odd things you can witness in GTA 6. Following the stench wafting from a deer carcass into the overgrowth will guide you to a totem that wouldn’t look too out of place in the first series of True Detective. You won’t be looking at it for long, though, before passing out; a pair of legs is the last thing you see.

This could be the end of this particular tale, unless you’re a keen reader of posters, that is. Dotted around the starting area of Key Lento are various flyers asking for information on “Skunk Ape”. Once read, a new contact will be added to your phone. Call Kirk, and he’ll offer to meet up at night, where you can carry on delving into the mystery. Don’t worry, he’s very friendly, and nothing sinister will occur from this point forward.

At the beginning of chapter two, you’ll be pointed in the direction of Kyle McKittrick, a local farmer in the Frogswater area who is in need of a pilot. Turns out, he’s recently broken his arm, so he needs help dusting his crops. That’s where you come in. Take off into the skies and follow his car around, making sure to feed his plants with all of the sweet nutrients they need. On the surface, this may sound like a rather mundane affair, and, to be fair, your first encounter with him will be. But revisit him whenever he’s in need of assistance and the true nature of the questline reveals itself. You’ll never look at a strawberry in the same way again.

Listen to any of the radio station news reports early in the game and you may well hear stories about a “No Flushers” movement — a group proposing a conspiracy theory related to Leonida’s waste management. Actually meeting the people involved won’t come naturally, though. In fact, it wasn’t until hour 80 of my playthrough that I stopped at a notice board in Port Gellhorn to scan a bulletin that led me to them. Once contacted, you’ll be asked to go to a waffle restaurant in Vice City where you’ll meet Dr. Merle. A man with a plan, he’ll flush on this one occasion after eating an intentionally stomach-churning selection from the menu, thus starting the quest for the truth. Follow the tracker he quite literally dumped into the sewage pipes and find where it leads for yourself. It’s bonkers.

There are many different ways to find some of Leonida’s most interesting side missions. Some spin-off from characters you’ll meet in the main story, others are found by the roadside, and some can even be triggered by a quick browse of Snapmatic. That’s how I stumbled upon Dodo Rising, an animal rights group protesting a chimp sanctuary near Vice City International Airport. Talk to them, hand over your info, and you’ll be roped into their fight as you infiltrate their target in an effort to save the apes. And that’s just the first of many missions you’ll be taking on with various quirky members of Dodo Rising, culminating in one of GTA 6’s most bizarre moments.

Not all of these missions are weird, though. Some are much more grounded and can surprise in more traditional ways. That’s the case with Yago, a hopeful street racer you first meet during chapter three. What on the surface looks like a pretty straightforward set of Tokyo Drift-esque races later reveals itself to be much more of a human story with a memorable ending. Even if racing isn’t your favourite GTA 6 side activity, it's very much worth playing through them just to see the hidden depths of Yago’s story, as his inner turmoil battles against the situation he finds himself in.

Who doesn’t love to see a crypto scheme crumble? Well, in GTA 6, maybe it could actually be of benefit to jump on the Bitcoin train if money is foremost on your mind. Such an opportunity presents itself near Ocean Beach in Vice City, with the stuntman extraordinaire, Papa Audacity. This showman/charlatan, depending on your viewpoint, ropes Jason and Lucia into several marketing campaigns for the launch of his Audacity coin. It not only involves several very funny interactions with him and his cronies across the city, but also introduces you to the many different types of stunt challenges that are available to you in its open world. Your first meeting with him may not go quite to plan, but fear not, the type of evil that lurks in the blockchain always finds a way of returning.

And finally, Lucia’s friend Andy plays a big part in chapter one of GTA 6, but she returns much later on as an optional mission giver. Having moved from her Key Lento surroundings, she’s got a new home and job in the plush suburb of Belville, and invites Lucia to visit her. Little does Lucia know that this is to be something more than a friendly house call. Instead, she’s roped into helping out with some deliveries for Cellerica, an unusual new business program.

Deliver your first package to the women around town, and from there you can continue to climb up that Cellerica chain. It’s worth doing to see the story play out, even if it soon seems like a really bad idea to do so. I don’t know about you, but I’d rather set myself on fire than join what I’m sure is a perfectly legitimate business with nothing to hide.

And these are just a handful. There are many, many more mysteries and side quests to find around Leonida. Some are even weirder and wilder than any listed above. Like, for example, if you happen to see an abandoned car near the Starlet Motel with a trail of clothes stretching into the woods, go and check that one out for yourself. If you’re brave enough.

articles.title: Invincible Season 5 Premieres on February 17, 2027
articles.summary: Invincible’s next season flies onto Prime Video on February 17, 2027, and Skybound celebrated with a cheeky trailer teasing what’s next for Mark Grayson and his superpowered compatriots.
articles.body:
Invincible’s next season flies onto Prime Video on February 17, 2027, and Skybound celebrated with a cheeky trailer teasing what’s next for Mark Grayson and his superpowered compatriots.

Fans won’t have to wait much longer to see what comes of the Viltrumites’ big plans, as Season 5 hits streaming on February 17 next year. In fact, it’ll be less than a year between seasons, since Season 4 was released in March 2026.

Prime Video released a humorous advertisement for Season 5 on November 19, showing Mark sitting across from Damien Darkblood at Burger Mart, his regular fast-food haunt that’s packed with a crowd of all-too-familiar faces.

In his chat with Damien, Mark grills the demon detective about whisking him away to hell, seemingly poking fun at fans’ discussions of the side quest.

“You owe me and everyone else for your fun little diversion. It’s more filler than these burgers,” Mark scolds Damien, asking him what he plans on doing to “make up” for his hellish misadventure. Viewers can’t help but notice the likes of Lucan, Anissa, and Kregg in the background.

Damien then explains everything he’s been doing over the last year to help bring Season 5 to life in a montage, where viewers are shown a brief glimpse of a script that opens with a bank robbery. Other than that, we don’t get to see much else — but as Damien points out, the upcoming release date is pretty “exciting.”

Amazon gave us a bit more to chew on in an official press release. The logline for Invincible Season 5 is as follows: “Still reeling from his role in the Earth-shattering events of last season, in Season Five, Mark searches for a way to make the world better, even if that means risking everything — including the relationships, friends, and allies he holds dear. Mark’s forced to decide what kind of hero he is and what he’s willing to do to save his planet’s future — and if the ends always justify the means when millions of lives hang in the balance.”

IGN scored the final episode of Invincible Season 5 a strong 9 out of 10 , with reviewer Siddhant Adlakha calling it the show’s “strongest season yet” that “concludes with a quiet, emotionally affecting entry.”

This is the latest exciting news for the franchise after Season 6 was confirmed in June 2026. Creator Robert Kirkman released a statement remarking on this early renewal, writing, “One of the biggest rewards of building Invincible over the years has been witnessing how new audiences continue to connect with these characters and this world, almost 25 years after its creation.

“This renewal is as much a testament to the passion of our fans as it is to the talented teams bringing the series to life, including longtime supervising directors Shaun O’Neill and Dan Duncan, who have done so much behind the scenes to make Invincible a success, and will now help us continue to grow as executive producers. There’s still so much story left to tell, and I can’t wait for fans to see what’s ahead in seasons 5, 6, and beyond.”

Invincible VS , the 3v3 tag fighting game based on the comic book series-turned-TV show, is also up for Best Fighting Game at the 2026 Game Awards. You can read more about the nominees here, and check out what could be coming next for the game in our exclusive interview with its developers .

articles.body:
With GTA 6 finally launching this week, there's been no shortage of retailers offering early discounts on Rockstar's long-awaited Grand Theft Auto sequel, but Argos has gone one better with a new bundle deal that gets you an extra PS5 DualSense controller for a good amount less.

Whilst Amazon UK has recently been listing Grand Theft Auto VI for £64.95 , alongside the DualSense now going for £42.99 in an early Black Friday deal, Argos has managed to undercut both with an all-time low combined price.

Save On This GTA 6 And Controller Bundle At Argos

GTA VI (PS5) + DualSense Controller Bundle

Specifically, you can now buy GTA 6 on PS5 with a DualSense controller for just £99.98 at Argos , down from the £109.98 total price you'd otherwise pay for the two together. For comparison, this limited-time offer (running until the 3rd of December) beats Amazon’s combined £107.94 price by £8.56.

To put Argos’ savings into another perspective, since GTA 6 is currently listed for £64.99 at the retailer, you're effectively getting the extra gamepad for only £34.99 — or, alternatively, bringing the game's price down to £54.99, if you were planning on buying a new or extra DualSense anyway.

Mind you, this offer doesn't include every PS5 controller colour scheme. You'll have to choose between the original White DualSense or Midnight Black version, both featuring the usual haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and built-in microphone. Neither controller is one of the special GTA 6 editions .

Amazon’s DualSense deal, on the other hand, includes lots of alternative colour schemes at its new £42.99 deal price: White, Midnight Black, Cosmic Red, Grey Camo (surprisingly even lower at £39.94 ), Nova Pink, and Starlight Blue.

If you’ve only just started looking into grabbing a GTA 6 preorder, you’ll also need to remember that this boxed copy of GTA 6 doesn't actually include a physical disc. Instead, you'll receive a download code inside the case, along with an A3 double-sided poster.

The code can already be used to preload the game ahead of its November 19 release, but requires a UK-registered PlayStation account.

articles.title: Madden Review: Director David O. Russell Fumbles This Biopic of the Football Icon And Video Game Franchise Namesake
articles.summary: Director David O. Russell fumbles Madden. The movie never makes football particularly interesting, thus failing to connect viewers to the driving force of its subject’s life.
articles.body:
David O. Russell’s erratically directed Madden is an assemblage of montages in search of a story. Is Madden about the relationship between Oakland Raiders coach John Madden and team owner Al Davis? Is it about John’s struggles to be a husband and father when football’s no longer consuming his life? Is it about John proving himself as an announcer? Is it about the creation of EA’s Madden video game franchise ?

Madden the movie casts a wide net around all those topics while never satisfactorily exploring them in any real depth or detail, the whole endeavor playing out like SNL skit after SNL skit without anything ever feeling emotionally genuine. It’s one frantically edited, half-explored sequence set to vintage needledrops after another.

Nicolas Cage is packed into a fat suit and prosthetics as the NFL icon, coming across more like a stage actor starring in Shrek the Musical than a real flesh-and-blood person. Yes, John Madden was an over-the-top figure in real life but the movie and Cage turn him into a cartoon character or the big, bumbling oafish dad in a sitcom. ( Will Ferrell was reportedly up to play Madden before Cage.)

Christian Bale is similarly reduced to makeup and mugging as Al Davis, only occasionally hinting at a real person underneath that greasy, gaudy exterior. Davis’ drive to “just win, baby” certainly fed Madden’s hunger for the game and for victory on the field. Their symbiotic relationship here tries to be the film’s main focus, but the slight story never digs much deeper than the superficial.

John and Al seem made for each other but there's almost a manipulative pusher and junkie dynamic at play. At one point, John tries to break free from Al’s hold over him, but the film is reluctant to show any of its characters in too negative a light.

For both Madden and Davis, it’s their wives – Virginia Madden and Carol Davis, respectively – who help illuminate their larger-than-life spouse’s vulnerabilities, with Kathryn Hahn faring better than Sienna Miller in having an impact. As Virginia, Hahn finds the humor and heart in an otherwise underwritten character (Miller’s Carol is the far more thankless role). Still, Hahn’s is arguably the most emotionally genuine performance in the film.

After a few teases early on, the last half hour of the movie hones in on the creation of the Madden video game . This sequence finally offers the movie a bit more focus and some conflict between John and Al, as the latter doesn’t want John to contribute his time and knowledge to what he deems an inconsequential endeavor when he could come back to work for the Raiders. The SNL skit vibe of the whole film isn’t helped by the casting of John Mulaney as EA’s Trip Hawkins, with the entire EA staff and their endeavor depicted as a bunch of nerds who learn how to be jocks thanks to John Madden’s football know-how.

It’s all pretty condescending. The EA staff are all portrayed as stereotypical geeks, right down to their costuming. In reality, EA’s video game designers of that time were depicted as being akin to rock musicians , not hapless dweebs. Still, there might have at least been a fun Revenge of the Nerds-style film in here had Madden chosen to just chronicle this one chapter of John Madden’s life. Instead, the film is merely a highlight reel, with none of Madden’s accomplishments feeling any more special than the rest.

Between 2022’s Amsterdam and now Madden, director David O. Russell has lost his filmmaking footing after a decade-plus of solid movies (Three Kings, The Fighter , Silver Linings Playbook , American Hustle ). Madden is bewildering in its sloppiness and inability to commit to telling a focused story that does its beloved subject justice.

articles.title: An Estimated 2 Million Eager Xbox Gamers Made Use of the 'New Zealand Trick' to Play GTA 6 Early
articles.summary: Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “New Zealand trick,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.
articles.body:
Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “ New Zealand trick ,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.

This happens fairly often for games with a local midnight launch, but GTA 6 saw an unprecedented number of people pretending to be Kiwis. 2 million U.S. and U.K. players took a little trip to New Zealand on November 18 on Xbox alone, according to Ampere Analysis.

1.5m Xbox users in the U.S. took advantage of the loophole, and 600,000 U.K. Xbox users jumped right in with them. The data also only shows some of the story. Playing early is as easy as changing a setting on Xbox, but PlayStation players have to create a whole new account based in the country, and import PSN currency to spend on the store.

These frustrating hoops mean the number was likely significantly lower on PS5, but it probably still wasn’t an insignificant number of people considering GTA 6 game sales are expected to lean heavily towards Sony’s platform. So, the total number of fans using the New Zealand trick will be higher.

New Zealand's official tourism board recently celebrated the launch of GTA 6 by welcoming gamers taking advantage of the trick. "One perk of seeing the sun first? Getting GTA 6 first too," said the post on the New Zealand tourist board's Instagram account.

"We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we'd love to have you."

While technically against the terms and services of Xbox and PlayStation, the loophole seems to be an accepted grey area for Microsoft and Sony, in so much as neither has said or done anything to clamp down (we've asked for comment). In fact, Xbox has flaunted the trick as a feature for previous game releases. “Kia Ora to all the people who moved to NZ last night!” Microsoft said a Twitter post from Xbox in 2021, celebrating the launch of Forza Horizon 5.

Whether you took the trip or managed to white knuckle it through to the official launch, GTA 6 is finally here and it’s worth the wait. GTA 6 is now the highest rated game of all time . Crikey.

articles.summary: The Radeon RX 9070 XT nearly matches the peformance of the now-$1,500+ GeForce RTX 5070 Ti.
articles.body:
Best Buy is offering a solid deal on a PC that's perfectly suited to run the latest games in 4K. For Black Friday, you can pick up the Acer Nitro 65 Radeon 9070XT prebuilt gaming PC for just $1,889.99 with free shipping after a $410 off instant discount. The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a powerful GPU that nearly matches the performance of the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, which currently can't be found for under $1,500 for the GPU alone.

Acer Nitro 65 Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $1,890

Acer Nitro AMD Ryzen 9 9900X Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC (32GB/1TB)

The Acer Nitro gaming PC is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 9 9900X CPU, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD. The AMD Ryzen 9 9900X is a 12-core, 24-thread Zen 5 CPU with a max turbo boost of 5.6GHz, making it a solid multi-purpose CPU for gaming, productivity, and even AI. 32GB of RAM is plenty of memory for any gamer and the 1TB SSD is adequate storage for a boot drive. The CPU is air-cooled with a tower heatsink fan design and the system runs off a generous 850W power supply.

The Radeon RX 9070 XT Received a 10/10 at IGN

The AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT was the only 2025-released GPU that we gave a 10/10 score . This is the least expensive graphics card from either AMD or Nvidia that I would comfortably recommend for playing the latest and most demanding games in 4K at 60fps. Even though the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is considerably more expensive in today's market, the 9070 XT matches it or beats in several of the games we tested. This doesn't factor in frame gen or ray tracing, where the RTX 5070 Ti demonstrates a clear advantage, but if you want those technologies you'll have to pay dearly for them.

articles.title: GTA 6 Features a Few Cheeky Dexter Easter Eggs
articles.summary: GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating the TV serial killer would be referenced in the game.
articles.body:
GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating that the TV serial killer might be referenced in the game.

Rockstar is known for including Easter eggs and nods to films, television, and even other games in the GTA franchise, so naturally, fans expected that Dexter might be referenced in GTA 6. The original TV series took place in Miami from 2006 to 2013, though subsequent revivals and sequel shows moved the series to New York. Many hoped that Rockstar would give a nod to the famous serial killer, who's best known for taking out bad guys — and it appears that they have.

Dexter's apartment can be found in Vice City, specifically near the top of Washington Island. The residence is inside a complex named "Trinity Apartments," seemingly in reference to one of Dexter's most famous villains, the Trinity Killer. If you go to his actual apartment, you will find an AC unit exactly where you'd expect it to be based on its positioning in the show. The AC unit in the series is used as a hiding place for Dexter's trophies, a box of glass slides with the blood of various people he has killed. If you head to the roof, you will also find a knife, rope, and even a syringe, which Dexter uses to sedate people.

Dexter Easter Eggs in Grand Theft Auto 6 🔥 💥 Dexter's Apartment at 'Trinity Apartments' 💥 'Slice of Life' Boat 💥 Tools on Roof including Syringe Located on Washington Island (Vice Beach) — DETONATED (@DETONATEDcom) November 19, 2026

Dexter Easter Eggs in Grand Theft Auto 6 🔥 💥 Dexter's Apartment at 'Trinity Apartments' 💥 'Slice of Life' Boat 💥 Tools on Roof including Syringe Located on Washington Island (Vice Beach)

And finally, you can also find a boat docked near the complex that looks very similar to Dexter's own aquatic vehicle, the Slice of Life. It's unclear if there are any other Dexter Easter eggs in the game, but if you want to find all of these for yourselves, watch the end of the video embedded above. It's possible that there is even a mass grave of body bags under the ocean or a serial killer running around for players to find, but these are things that might take a lot longer to discover.

Either way, it's a fun nod to a beloved show. We included the TV series on a list of films and shows fans should acquaint themselves with prior to GTA 6's release , expecting that there may be some Easter eggs for them. Other players have found references to Miami-based films such as Scarface, as well, so there are plenty of pop culture references to keep an eye out for while playing the game.

articles.title: Amazon Is Discounting a Cloud Buster Sword Replica for Black Friday This Year
articles.body:
Nintendo recently dropped a major discount on Final Fantasy VII Remake and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, so naturally I caved and bought both ( they were under $8 !). That deal has come and gone, but after dumping too many hours into this game, I now understand the hype.

For long-time fans of the series, a discount on the best Final Fantasy games may not be all that enticing. But with Amazon's Black Friday sale happening now, there's a number of FF7-themed gifts available at a discount. One such deal is this incredible Cloud Strife replica sword. It's made out of stainless steel and is currently discounted to its lowest price since Prime Day .

articles.title: Ulster SFC: Armagh to begin defence of the Anglo Celt Cup against Derry
articles.summary: Armagh will begin the defence of their Ulster Senior Football Championship title in 2027 with a home quarter-final against Derry.
articles.body:
Armagh will begin the defence of their Ulster Senior Football Championship title in 2027 with a home quarter-final against Derry.

Kieran McGeeney's side ended an 18-year wait for the Anglo Celt Cup in May when coming through against Monaghan in an extra-time thriller.

The Orchard men, who were excluded from a return to the preliminary round having began their 2026 campaign at that stage, host Derry who were last champions in 2023 when they came through on penalties against Armagh.

The winner will face either Donegal or Down who have been drawn together for the second year in a row.

The Mournemen caused a huge shock when defeating a fancied Donegal side in Letterkenny but would fall to eventual winners Armagh in the last four.

On the other side of the draw, Cavan have been drawn to host Fermanagh in the preliminary round with Antrim awaiting the winners.

Whomever comes through those games will meet either Tyrone or Monaghan who have been paired in another mouthwatering tie.

The Red Hands fell to Armagh in the preliminary round this year after extra time with Monaghan seeking to go one step further next year having reached the 2026 final. Both counties bounced back to reach the last eight of the All-Ireland series.

In Connacht, All-Ireland champions Mayo are drawn to face Nestor Cup holders Roscommon at the quarter-final stage.

The winner will meet Eamonn Fitzmaurice's Galway - who enjoy the benefit of the bye into the last four.

On the opposite side of the draw, Sligo will make the trip to face New York with the winner facing either London or Leitrim at the semi-final stage.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath claimed Leinster honours in 2026 and they will open their defence at the quarter-final stage against Meath or Offaly.

Louth, who reached this year's All-Ireland semi-final, will have designs on regaining the Delaney Cup having won it in 2025 and they face Oisin McConville's Wicklow - who won this year's Tailteann Cup - in the last eight.

On the other side of the draw, Ger Brennan's Dublin will face the winner of the preliminary round tie between Laois and Carlow, while Kildare await the winner of Wexford v Longford in the last eight.

In Munster, Kerry's bid for a seventh-straight title will open with a semi-final against either Clare or Waterford, while Cork are also straight through to the last four where they will face either Tipperary or Limerick.

With the round robin system in place for the provincial hurling championships, no draw is required.
