articles.title: Ubisoft Creates Generative AI Game Studio Called Motherbrain
articles.summary: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in its games.
articles.body:
Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in games.

Ubisoft’s latest earnings report , published on November 19, 2026, included a segment explaining its new operating model. Part of this model is a subsidiary called Motherbrain, which focuses on “AI for gameplay innovation” to “support all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences.”

Further down in its report, Ubisoft reveals that the developers at Motherbrain are also the team behind its first playable, generative AI experience called Teammates. This new AI-focused studio will “develop proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences.”

The Art of Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced Preview Gallery

Ubisoft explains that Motherbrain is focused on creating “new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory, and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds.” Motherbrain was founded to “serve creators globally, both within Ubisoft’s Creative House ecosystem and beyond, and form partnerships with selected technology actors.”

The existence of Teammates isn’t a surprise; Ubisoft revealed the project late last year, which some members of the media were able to play. It’s described as an immersive first-person shooter where players are accompanied by two robotic AI companions that they can order around using real-time voice commands.

Speaking with VideoGamesChronicle , Teammates’ narrative director Virginie Mosser described AI as a “tool,” positing that it isn’t something that will ultimately replace entire swaths of the industry. “It’s a tool first. We’ve been working on it for more than two years now, and our conclusion is that it’s a super cool tool, but it’s still a tool,” she told the outlet.

The reveal of this AI-focused studio, however, comes amid sweeping layoffs for those within the games industry. Just today, Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs , hemorrhaging 116 jobs across two of its major studios. And earlier this year, 40 jobs were cut at its Toronto studio, coinciding with a change in leadership with the exit of former creative director Clint Hocking.

Currently, Ubisoft is hard at work on the next generation of Assassin’s Creed games, one of those being Project Hexe , a highly-anticipated installment in the series set during the European Witch Trials.

News of Ubisoft’s new AI studio follows a few viral AI-related moments within the gaming industry lately; earlier this week, Embark Studios came under fire after replacing esports commentators on a highlight reel with its AI-powered characters from The Finals, and just yesterday, former Take-Two CEO Ben Feder said that the Western game market is just “ one Toy Story moment away from consumer acceptance of AI in video games.”

articles.title: Video Game Spending Dropped 14% This October, Possibly Because Everyone Was Preparing for GTA 6
articles.summary: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.
articles.body:
The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.

A new report from market research firm Circana shows that gamers were a bit more frugal this October than they were last year, despite two major games releasing that month. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on October 23, and Gears of War: E-Day released on October 1. Both games enjoyed reasonable critical reception, though reviews for Modern Warfare 4 were rather mixed .

It’s worth noting that sales for E-Day paled in comparison to the rave reviews it received, with analysts estimating that the game only sold 400,000 copies across both console and PC as of October 30. And last October, Battlefield 6 rocked players’ wallets as one of the best-selling games in the entire series — and, indeed, the best-selling game of the entire year — so it’s not a head-scratcher that this was a tough act for MW4 and E-Day to follow.

Circana’s report found that consumer spending on console, specifically, fell 18% from last year, and compared this trend to sales from Battlefield 6 and Pokémon Legends: Z-A . The report pointed to a 16% decline in mobile spending as the primary driver of this drop in addition to Battlefield's booming sales from last October.

However, it’s hard to ignore the impact that GTA 6 has had on the industry at large. Earlier this month, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed that the release of the world’s most highly anticipated game likely had an impact on the lower-than-expected sales for NBA 2K27, as well as other titles.

“I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far,” he told IGN in an exclusive interview . “It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”

The launch of GTA 6 has proven to be a massive and unprecedented moment in pop culture history, to the point where analysts saw a 17% increase in time off requests for its release date on November 19. Even world governments were hopping on the bandwagon, with Australia’s workplace regulator reminding employees of their rights to PTO in a viral post last month. Germany also boasts a program that allows workers to take time off for professional development to play the game.

If that wasn’t wild enough, a U.S. Army Battalion even advertised a special reenlistment incentive that gave service members four days of paid leave that directly coincided with GTA 6’s release, which 43 soldiers ended up taking . It remains to be seen if GTA 6 will really save the average gamer $5,000 by staying indoors, but so many people have hopped online to play that internet service providers reported a massive spike in traffic from Xbox consoles.

articles.title: You Can Now Buy the Steam Machine Without a Reservation – But Supplies Are Limited
articles.summary: Back when the Steam Machine first came out in June, it was in short supply, due to the limited amount of hardware Valve was able to get its hands on (thanks, RAM crisis). But now, about 5 months after launch, you can finally just buy a Steam Machine.
articles.body:
When the Steam Machine first came out in June, it was in short supply, due to the limited amount of hardware Valve was able to get its hands on (thanks, RAM crisis). Now, about 5 months after launch, you can finally just buy a Steam Machine.

Valve put out a blog post on November 19 giving an update on Steam Machine reservations, revealing that it had just finished out sending purchase invites to anyone on the reservation list for the 2TB model. The 512GB version, though, is now available to purchase on the Steam store page without a reservation. However, it looks like Valve doesn't have the components on hand to make the 2TB model available in the same way.

According to Valve's blog, the ongoing memory shortage is particularly impacting the 2TB Steam Machine because of its much larger drive. The company says the amount of people on the waitlist for the 2TB Machine exceeds what there were able to make, and while it's going to make more, it's going to be at a limited rate.

Still, Valve was able to get through its 512GB Steam Machine waitlist much earlier than expected. When the mini PC launched, some people were placed on the waitlist with an expected order time of 2027. Luckily, the new year hasn't ticked over, and the Machine is now available to buy for anyone that wants it... but there is a possibility that Valve will sell through its entire supply.

Valve does say that it's going to continue to build the Machine, but it sounds like the production run is going to be limited. It says that "memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result, we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them."

It's no secret that the RAM crisis has been particularly unforgiving to the Steam Machine, and it's not likely to let up in the near future. Samsung told investors in an earnings call last month that it expects supply to be more constrained next year, and all three of the major RAM manufacturers have sold through their manufacturing capacity through next year.

It doesn't seem likely that the memory and storage costs that are limiting how many Steam Machines Valve can make will let up at all in the near future. From the way that blog post ended by saying it doesn't know how many Steam Machines it can make or how expensive they're going to be, it's very likely that the mini PC is either going to get a hearty price rise in January, or just be discontinued until Valve can make a followup when prices go down. Either way, it's a shame – the Steam Machine is an excellent little computer, and the RAM crisis unfortunately made it a non-starter for a lot of people, due to the price.

articles.title: GTA 6's Viral NPC May Actually Have a Dark Secret
articles.summary: A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral since the game's launch for being a total smokeshow, but she also seems to have a dark secret.
articles.body:
A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral for being a total smokeshow, but fans are also noticing that she seems to have a dark secret.

Early on in the game, Brian sends Jason to go retrieve rent from a tenant named Mandy, who refuses to pay until her sink is fixed. Once you get there, it's clear she has staged a maintenance emergency so Jason would turn up. She's madly obsessed with him, but Jason pays no mind, since he's still pursuing Lucia. She eventually tries to seduce Jason with a skimpy bikini, to no avail. He ends up pulling out whatever is lodged in her sink, which she quickly takes and runs off with.

Mandy eventually gets irritated with Jason's disinterest and kicks him out, but if players linger around the property, they may start to realize Mandy isn't just obsessive because she has a crush... but because she may be a killer. If you wander into her backyard, you will see a freshly covered-up, body-sized hole next to a few tubs of acid. But hey, maybe it's just a coincidence! If you pop the trunk of her car, you will also see more acid and tools someone might use to kidnap and kill a person. And if you take a quick look at what was in Mandy's sink, it appears to be a severed finger.

While it's unclear if she's actually a serial killer (it takes three victims to be classified as one, by the way), she does appear to have killed at least one person. It's unclear who the other guy is, but it's possible Jason could've met a similar fate. Does she seduce people in order to kill them? Or does she kill them because they reject her advances or hurt her emotionally? It's hard to say. Either way, it seems clear that there's definitely a screw loose, and it's good that Jason didn't fall for her seduction.

If you enjoy listening to music while you run or work out, then you should consider getting a headset that's specifically designed for it. Shokz is one of the best known and well-respected sport headphone brands and, fortunately for you, the Shokz Black Friday Sale has officially kicked off on Amazon .

33% Off the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Sport Headphones

Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Open-Ear Wireless Bone Conduction Sport Headphones

The OpenRun Pro 2 looks like a neckband style headphone except that a lightweight titanium band connecting the two ear pieces wraps around the back of your head instead of resting on your neck. This design does an excellent job of keeping everything in place, perfect for active exercise.

Instead of the traditional method of sending sound vibrations to your eardrums, the OpenRun Pro uses bone conduction technology to send vibrations through your cheekbones directly to your inner ear. As such, the headphones are actually placed in front of your ear instead of on your ear. The biggest advantage is that you can fully hear your surroundings; if you like running on streets, for example, you'll be aware of everything that's going on around you while your music is playing.

The new OpenRun Pro 2 utilizes Shok's DualPitch technology to virtually eliminate vibrations. Other smaller changes include increased battery life and improved mic quality.

I have a pair of AirPods Pro that I use regularly, but I always set them aside for the OpenRun Pros when I run. The Transparency mode on the AirPods Pro does work well for most situations, but they still can't compare to the awareness you get without having any buds plugging up your ears. articles.title: GTA 6 Has Police Departments Across America Begging People Not to Commit Crimes IRL
articles.summary: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.
articles.body:
GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.

GTA 6 is finally here, and you can carry out many of your wildest criminal fantasies. It's a very freeing experience, and Rockstar has added more depth than ever before to make crimes like simple robberies more intricate and nuanced. However, the usual suspects when it comes to a new GTA game (mainstream news outlets, like Fox News ) have expressed concern over what kind of impact this might have on society. Will it create real rampant crime or spikes in violence? Probably not, but police departments across the country have created PSAs to ask people not to commit crime.

The Atlanta Police Department put out a post asking people to express their more radical desires in-game and not in real life.

GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮 Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions. Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences. Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets. — Atlanta Police Department (@Atlanta_Police) November 17, 2026

GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮 Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions. Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences. Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets.

The police department in San Juan, Texas have asked players to keep their behavior in-game, noting that a six star wanted level in real life is not a challenge, but a criminal jail sentence.

It's a bit of fun to likely ride the GTA 6 hype wave. You'd be hard pressed to find a major company that isn't trying to capture GTA 6's excitement in some way right now, and it seems like even local governments are doing the same thing. As is always the case with GTA, there are some folks expressing concern over the game's contents. One concerned group in particular is the furry community , which is mocked in-game. Furries are illegal in GTA 6 and as a result, the police hunt them down and point weapons at them. It's pretty absurd, but some real furries don't find it very amusing.

This is all par for the course for this franchise, but it does seem like more non-gamers are trying to have fun with it since it's such a massive cultural event. As of right now, we don't know how well GTA 6 has sold, but it looks like it's going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history.

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

27" Alienware AW2726DM QHD QD-OLED Gaming Monitor

Most people would agree that OLED monitors are as good as it gets for gaming. They're also really expensive. Well, Alienware is bucking the trend with one of its latest 2026 OLED releases. The 27" Alienware AW2726DM QHD 240Hz QD-OLED gaming monitor is listed at an already reasonable retail price of $349.99, but for Black Friday it's down to just $279.99 with free shipping. This is a 27" 2560x1440 (QHD) monitor that incorporates a Samsung quantum dot OLED ( QD OLED ) panel, which is brighter and has a wider color gamut than the more commonly found W-OLED panel.

39" Alienware AW3926QW 5K RGB Tandem Stripe OLED Monitor

Earlier this year, Dell announced the "world's first 39" 5K monitor with RGB stripe tandem OLED technology."It launched with a retail price of $1,099.99 but for Black Friday you can get it for $100 less . The Alienware AW3926QW has no lack of features that make it stand out from the crowd, but perhaps its most impressive inclusion is the LG RGB stripe tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter (the AW3926QW in particular has a very impressive 1,300 nits of peak brightness) and 2) it's less prone to burn-in.

The AW3926QW doubles down on this with new RGB stripe technology. Whereas traditional tandem OLEDs use white pixels, RGB stripe tandem OLED breaks the color down further into vertically aligned red, green, and blue pixels. This reduces color fringing and in turn significantly improves text clarity. It goes without saying that there are obvious benefits here for both gaming and productivity purposes alike.

Alienware's most popular 4K OLED gaming monitor is also down to its lowest price ever. The AW3225QF is a rare gaming monitor that combines a native 4K resolution, 240Hz refresh rate , and a gorgeous Samsung-sourced quantum dot OLED panel. If you're looking for the best 4K gaming monitor , this should definitely be on your short list. The Alienware AW3225QF is HDR True Black 400 certified with up to 1,000 nits of peak brightness. It also boasts a factory calibrated 99.3% DCI-P3 color range, 1700R curve, and G-Sync certification .

In exchange for a lower refresh rate and no official G-Sync certification (it's still G-Sync compatible), you get better text clarity and arguably a better monitor for non-gaming use.

How to Find and Fix the Railing in GTA 6

To find the railing at Jason's home, head out onto the back porch and down the stairs to the gym setup . Next to the silver ladder is a broken portion of the porch railing that you can interact with and fix by holding Triangle / Y .

articles.title: How to Keep Stolen Cars - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Jason starts out with a few vehicles to his name, but you're not able to store new vehicles during Chapter 1. This official GTA 6 guide page will tell you
articles.body:
Jason starts out with a few vehicles to his name, but you're not able to store new vehicles during Chapter 1. This official GTA 6 guide page will tell you everything you need to know about when you unlock the ability store more vehicles.

Simply put, if you're just getting started in GTAVI, you won't be able to store vehicles early on asides from the ones that you start with, as you unlock the ability to do this by progressing the main story. You'll need to get about halfway through Chapter 2 before you can unlock this feature.

When you start Chapter 2, you will be able to store unregistered vehicles temporarily at your safehouse by parking them in your safehouse parking spaces. Be warned that these vehicles aren't yours to keep permanently though! Once your unregistered vehicle is out on the road, you may lose it if the vehicle gets damaged beyond repair, if you get Wasted (die) or Busted (arrested), or if it gets left behind during the course of a mission or through normal gameplay.

To keep stolen cars permanently, you will need to unlock the ability to "register" stolen vehicles, which you get by progressing further into Chapter 2.

During Chapter 2, you'll meet someone called Moses when you go to complete the main mission called " Moses ". He'll give you new ways to interact with stolen cars and register them for your personal use (for a fee), among other things.

Registering cars makes them yours to keep . You can only have one car registered for each character to start with, so you may need to sell one of your vehicles early on if you're keen to keep something new, but you will unlock more storage later.

For more info about completing this mission and the various unlocks you'll earn, visit the official Moses Walkthrough page.

After meeting Moses and completing this introductory mission, he asks you to go and steal a particular vehicle for him. This starts a mission called " Daily Driver ", where he tasks you with stealing back a vehicle that clients didn't pay him for.

Visit this separate walkthrough page to help you with stealing this vehicle as part of our Chapter 2 Walkthrough.

Once you complete this mission, Moses rewards you with a garage in Port Gellhorn which you can now use to store one more vehicle!

With storage facilities unlocked, you also get the Vice City Real Estate app unlocked for use on your phone, which allows your characters to purchase more garages around Leonida. Each new property varies in cost (starting at $5,000), and each property offers you one more storage location each.

You can store unregistered vehicles in an empty garage you own, so long as said vehicle isn't equipped with a tracker. You can do this by driving the vehicle to the garage and parking it inside. It will then stay put until you go back to the garage to collect it. Like parking in a safehouse parking space though, this is a temporary storage solution, as the vehicle is not registered to you.

You can tell if a vehicle is equipped with a tracker by scanning the vehicle with the WAiNK app, or by pressing D-pad Down on the D-Pad when driving the vehicle. If the tracker logo is present above the map screen, then the car you're driving has a tracker!

Trackers are usually present on newer vehicles, expensive vehicles, or custom vehicles.

There is a limit for how many vehicles can be registered to your characters at one time, but having more space to store vehicles increases the number of vehicles you can have registered at once. You can then swap between your active registered vehicles (indicated by blue icons on the map) and vehicles stored in your garages by either driving to the garage yourself and swapping the cars over, or by using the Scooter Bros app to have one of your stored registered vehicles delivered to you for a fee.

articles.body:
A Glimpse of Eternity is a side quest in Enshrouded that sends you into Veilwater Basin to find and explore five hidden tombs. Four of them hold the secret to eternal spells, so it’s a crucial quest for spellcasters. This side quest walkthrough will show you the location of all five tombs and the special Lore book at the end of each one.

You can start A Glimpse of Eternity after you complete Obtaining a Mill for the Alchemist. At that point, you can ask him about “A Glimpse of Eternity” to start this quest.

To complete A Glimpse of Eternity, you’ll need to find five hidden tombs spread throughout Veilwater Basin. Balthazar only gives you an easy quest markers to lead you to the first one. You’ll have to find the next four yourself. That is, unless you use this walkthrough. Herein, we’ll show you the location and end goal for each temple so you can proceed quickly through this quest:

The first Hidden Tomb is the only one that gets an objective marker. It’s north of Dragondream Lake in a cavern. You’ll know you’ve reached it when you see the stone columns in a roughly square shape.

Dig through the rubble at the southeast corner of the square tomb to unearth the stairs down into it. Then take the stairs down.

At the end of the tomb, you’ll find a Lore book on a pedestal titled “Experiments of Eternity.” Read it to advance the quest and learn a bit about the next tomb.

The next tomb is far to the south, past Dragondream lake and Gateway Outpost “Darkwater.” You can get there by following the road south from the outpost and turning west between the cliffs. You’ll see it standing tall on your left, covered in wisteria.

Dig through the rubble at the northwest corner of the tomb, beneath the big bush, to unearth the entrance.

At the end of this tomb, you’ll find a Lore book titled “Ashes of Eternity.” Read it to advance the quest and unlock a new recipe: Eternal Fireball II.

The third tomb is east of Goldrock Saddle, in a rock formation at the base of the cliffs. You can glide straight there from the Veilwater Basin Ancient Spire by heading north first, then turning sharply east.

There’s no digging to enter this tomb, and it’s a pretty straight shot to the back where you’ll find a Lore book titled “The Spell That Betrayed Me.” Read it to advance the quest and learn the recipe for Eternal Heal Beam I.

The fourth hidden tomb is a little unusual because you don’t actually have to go through the tomb at all. You can enter via the Hidden Tomb south of Cromville, which lets out at another tomb further south. You can actually skip straight ahead to the next step if you want to save yourself some time.

At the end of the tomb, you’ll surface on a cliff further to the south. There, you’ll find a grave with a Lore note stuck to the gravestone. It’s called “Fast As Lightning,” and reading it unlocks the Eternal Arc Lightning I spell. You can also dig up the grave itself to find a Gold Chest.

The fifth and final tomb is far to the northwest near Stillwater Bay. It’s north of Little Lagoon, along the cliff by the Historic Battleground.

At the end of that tomb, you’ll find the last Lore book for this quest: “Frozen Eternity.” Reading it unlocks the Eternal Ice Bolt III spell and advances this quest to its conclusion.

Now that you’ve delved all five hidden tombs, return to the Alchemist to share your findings. He’ll congratulate you on your success, and you’ll earn 200 XP for completing the quest.

Grand Theft Auto 6 features two playable protagonists who can be in a relationship together, but can Jason and Lucia start a relationship or have sex with other characters? Everything you need to know about intimacy with other characters in GTA 6 can be found in this page.

Can Jason and Lucia Cheat on Each Other?

Unlike most other GTA games, there are no other characters that the player can start a relationship with or have sex with. That level of romance is reserved for Jason and Lucia's dynamic and how you choose to have them interact with each other.

While you can lean into, or away from, the romantic aspects of their relationship, you can't make it so that Jason and Lucia are no longer a part of each other's lives. This is Jason and Lucia's story, no matter how you engage with the relationship system. How close they are and how much they care about each other though is entirely up to you.

Jason and Lucia can both go to strip clubs (either together as a couple, or individually), and they can both opt-in for VIP lap dances. You can throw money at the dancers in the club (either on the dance floor or in a VIP lap dance), and if you throw most of your money at one dancer then they will remove some of their clothes, but that's as intimate as those interactions can be.

Also, in another atypical move for Grand Theft Auto, there are not any sex workers in Leonida who you can solicit, further cementing that intimate moments between characters in this game are primarily reserved for Jason and Lucia.

articles.title: GTA 6 breaks records as sales top $2bn - industry estimate
articles.summary: Rockstar Games ended a 13-year wait with what is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch ever.
articles.body:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have become the biggest entertainment launch in history following the blockbuster video game's launch on Thursday , after a 13-year wait.

Pre-orders and first day sales of the highly anticipated open-world action-adventure game reached more than 24.5 million units, raking in about $2.36bn (£1.8bn), according to analytics platform Sensor Tower.

In comparison, the highest grossing movie so far this year, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, made $2.5bn over its entire run in cinemas .

GTA 6's maker Rockstar and parent company Take-Two have not released details of the game's sales but said demand has been "unprecedented". The BBC has contacted both the firms for comment.

The game is the latest instalment in Rockstar's nearly three decade old crime simulator franchise, which has become one of the most popular games in history .

At its core, the series is a satirical take on the American dream, putting players in the shoes of career criminals in Leonida, the game's Florida-inspired state.

The latest release follows new characters Lucia and her partner Jason, a pair of small-time criminals.

GTA 6 is estimated to have cost more than $1bn to develop , which would make it the most expensive video game in history.

Sensor Tower said GTA 6 will be so popular that it will reduce the time gamers spend on other single-player titles by 10%.

The research firm said its estimates are based on email receipts data and other statistical sources that track millions of people daily. They also track public profiles across major gaming platforms like PlayStation and Xbox, where GTA 6 is available.

Around three quarters of the game's sales have been for the PlayStation 5 and the balance on Xbox, Sensor Tower said.

Niko Partners, a gaming market research firm, said it expects GTA 6 to make more than $3bn in sales worldwide this year.

That figure would rank GTA 6 among the highest-grossing entertainment releases ever, but it would still have some way to go to catch 1939's Gone with the Wind , which has made an estimated $4.5bn, adjusted for inflation.

Rockstar is expected to make even more money from GTA 6 over the coming years.

The New York-based studio has yet to announce when the game will be released for PCs or given a date for its multiplayer expansion, which will allow players to interact and go on missions with others over the internet.

If 2013's GTA 5 is any guide, multiplayer will add dozens more hours of gameplay and bring in even more revenue for Rockstar as players spend real money on in-game property, cars and other perks.

Anticipation for the blockbuster title has grown through repeated delays, following a 13-year wait.

GTA 6 has been hailed by some reviewers as one of the most impressive gaming experiences ever. Entertainment media site IGN described it as an "uncompromisingly engineered" masterpiece.

The release of GTA 6 at midnight on Thursday across various time zones saw many gamers stay up through the night, while some took the following day off to play.

Its launch broke Virgin Media O2's evening traffic record as people rushed to install GTA 6's huge 212GB file on consoles.

The game's graphic content has resulted in censorship in Japan and, like earlier GTA releases, is not approved for sale in mainland China.

articles.summary: The Greatest Game is a side quest in Enshrouded that sends you deep into the Kindlewastes to scout out a scavenger camp known as Deepcut. It’s in the
articles.body:
The Greatest Game is a side quest in Enshrouded that sends you deep into the Kindlewastes to scout out a scavenger camp known as Deepcut. It’s in the ruins of an old oasis in the desert, and the scavengers are dug in. This side quest walkthrough shows you how to start the quest and solve the ruin’s mysterious puzzle.

To start The Greatest Game, you must first complete Sun Temple Stories with the Carpenter. At that point, you can speak to the Hunter to begin this quest.

To complete The Greatest Game, you need to venture to Deepcut, far to the southwest in the Kindlewastes. You can glide most of the way there from the Ancient Spire, touching down on a road that leads south toward the marker. You’ll have to turn off the road at the big skeleton to find another path that leads to the front door of Deepcut.

Once there, you’ll need to clear out some scavengers to give yourself room to look around. There’s a door on the opposite side of the ruin leading to a silver sarcophagus and a silver chest on an upper floor, so that’s a good place to start.

The objective for the quest actually takes place beneath the bridge at the center of the ruins. You can safely reach the lower level via the stairs leading down near the entrance. The door you need to open is on the opposite end. You’ll need to push four buttons to open it, two on either side.

Turn to your right and swing across the gap to press the first button on the wall ahead. Then, turn left and jump onto the nearby foundation.

Walk along the wooden pole connecting that foundation to the next and look across to the wall on the opposite end. Shoot the button you see there, then turn around and return to the center.

Swing across to the west wall and turn to your right to find a third button. Shoot it and return to the center again.

Use your Grappling Hook to swing twice toward the door, then turn left to find the final button in the far corner. Press it and then return to the center to jump through the open door.

Loot the Gold Chest in the secret room to collect your reward, finish the quest, and earn yourself 150 XP.

articles.title: A Spinning Machine for the Hunter Walkthrough - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: A Spinning Machine For The Hunter is a main quest in Enshrouded that has you building a Spinning Machine out of parts you likely already have lying around.
articles.body:
A Spinning Machine For The Hunter is a main quest in Enshrouded that has you building a Spinning Machine out of parts you likely already have lying around. Unlike most production place quests, you don’t need to collect anything special to make it. This walkthrough will show you how to start the quest and how to throw together your new machine.

How to Start A Spinning Machine For The Hunter

You can start A Spinning Machine For The Hunter any time after you collect your first batch of Raw Wool. That might happen after Gathering Wool in the Albaneve Summits or if you just happened to pick some up from a scavenger. Once you pick up your first batch of it, talk to the Hunter about “Refining Wool For Better Gear” to begin this quest.

How to Complete A Spinning Machine For The Hunter

Completing A Spinning Machine For The Hunter is just a matter of building a Spinning Machine, placing it in your camp, and putting it to a bit of use. The recipe is quite doable, and you probably already have what you need for it:

Conifer Logs x3: Gathered by chopping down trees in the Albaneve Summits

Metal Scraps x5: Found all over Embervale.

Linen x1: Refined from Flax at the Spinning Wheel or Hand Spindle

Once you have the Spinning Machine, place it down in your base and open up its production queue. Select Wool from its list of recipes and give it all your Raw Wool.

Note: Taming Yaks is a great way to get a constant source of Wool. Plus, they're adorable.

Once you’ve refined some proper wool, head to the Huntress and use it to make Warm Padding. With that, the quest will be complete; you’ll earn 350 XP, and you now have a material used in many new armor crafting recipes!
